card.name: Partway through prefixed or hyphenated words
card.fires_on: Pieces inside longer words that are built with a prefix or hyphen, such as well-behaved, re-named, un-anaesthetised, clear-felled and non-watermarked. It fires on the piece just before the word's stem is completed.

modes.label: Hyphenated compounds
modes.description: A hyphen or piece after a prefix like re-, non-, well- or clear- where the stem follows.
modes.example: The following year it was re<<-n>>amed Indian Arrival Day.

modes.description: The middle of a rare or British-spelled word broken into pieces.

card.writes: It pushes toward word-start pieces that continue a word, like organ, categor, bapt and subsid.
card.plain: It marks a spot where a long or hyphenated word is still being spelled out and its ending is yet to come.
